name: Sea cave kayaking

seo.title: Sea Cave Kayaking, Koh Talabeng | Secret Travel & Tour
seo.metaDescription: Kayak into the sea cave of Koh Talabeng from Koh Lanta: a full day with island hopping and lunch on Koh Bubu, or half a day with the mangrove. From 1,000 THB.

h1: Sea cave kayaking at Koh Talabeng
lead: The sea cave of Koh Talabeng by kayak, from Thung Yee Peng pier: a full day with lunch on Koh Bubu, a day for two in one kayak, or half a day with the mangrove.
promise: The Koh Talabeng sea cave by kayak

day.title: Sea cave kayaking and mangrove
day.note: Times with ≈ are approximate and move with the tide and the weather. The afternoon trip follows the same programme from 14:00 to 17:00.

steps.text: Pickup at your hotel, then the drive to Thung Yee Peng pier on the east coast of Koh Lanta.
The Thung Yee Peng mangrove forest.
By longtail to Koh Talabeng, then on to Koh Ung for a look around.
The Talabeng sea cave by kayak.
The monkey point in the mangrove.
Back to Koh Lanta and transfer to your hotel.

included: Sit-on-top kayaks, paddles and life jackets

faq.a: The full day goes furthest, with Koh Ung, the sea cave and lunch on Koh Bubu. The Love kayak paddles in two places, the mangrove and the Talabeng sea cave, then passes Skull Island and Koh Phee by longtail. The half day keeps the sea cave and the mangrove in three hours.

faq.q: What is the Talabeng sea cave like?
faq.a: Koh Talabeng is a limestone island off the east coast of Koh Lanta Noi. You paddle into its sea caves, with stalactites and stalagmites above the water.
Monkeys live in the mangrove and every trip stops where they usually come down to the water. They are wild animals, so nobody can promise them.
Yes. Lunch, drinks and seasonal fruit come with every trip. The village entrance fee is the only extra.
Yes. Children from 4 to 11 have their own rate.

faq.q: Can we go in the rainy season?
faq.a: Yes. The kayak trips run all year.

legacyText.title: Kayaking Koh Lanta, Sea Caves and Mangroves | Secret Travel
intro: Every trip starts at Thung Yee Peng pier, on the east coast. The mangrove is calm, with monkeys and birds. Koh Talabeng has a sea cave you reach by kayak after a short ride on a longtail.
Half days leave in the morning, 9:30 to 12:30, or in the afternoon, 14:00 to 17:00. Full days run from 9:00 to 15:00 or 15:30.
legacyText.cardDescription: Sea caves, mangroves and island hopping by kayak, from a half day to a full day.
goodToKnow: Children from 4 to 11 pay the child rate.
Times can change with the tide and the weather.
legacyText.priceNote: Prices in Thai baht. The village entrance fee, 40 THB per adult and 20 THB per child from 4 to 11, is not included.
legacyText.caption: Sea cave
